facts: JanusDDG is a model for predicting sequence-based protein stability.
The model uses a thermodynamics-compliant approach through Two-Fronts Multi-Head Attention.
The research team is affiliated with the Computational Biomedicine Unit at the University of Turin, Italy.
The team includes Guido Barducci and Ivan Rossi among its members.
JanusDDG is a deep learning framework that predicts the change in Gibbs free energy (ΔΔG) from mutations.
The model uses protein language model (PLM) embeddings and a bidirectional cross-attention transformer.
JanusDDG outperforms traditional structure-based methods for predicting ΔΔG from sequence data.
The code for JanusDDG is available at https://github.com/compbiomed-unito/JanusDDG.

The study quantifies protein stability using the change in Gibbs free energy (∆∆𝐺). A positive ∆∆𝐺 indicates a stabilizing mutation. The research introduces JanusDDG, a deep learning model for predicting ∆∆𝐺. JanusDDG incorporates antisymmetry and transitivity to improve prediction accuracy.
JanusDDG is a sequence-based model for predicting protein stability.
The model utilizes bidirectional cross-attention to integrate wild-type and mutant sequence information.
JanusDDG outperforms existing models on benchmark datasets S669, S461, and S96.
The model demonstrates effectiveness in identifying stabilizing mutations through stability classification evaluations.
JanusDDG is a new sequence-based deep learning model for predicting protein stability changes due to mutations.
JanusDDG uses a bidirectional cross-attention architecture combined with protein language model embeddings.
The model excels in predicting the effects of multiple mutations compared to existing models.
The authors suggest future validation of JanusDDG across diverse mutation spectra and structural classes.
The JanusDDG model predicts protein stability changes due to mutations.
The blind test datasets used include S669, S461, S96, and PTmul-NR.
The training dataset S2450 was curated to enhance model accuracy.
JanusDDG's architecture utilizes embeddings from ESM2 and a Bidirectional Cross-Attention Transformer.
The JanusDDG only Antisym. model enforces antisymmetry in predictions.
JanusDDG FineTuned enhances the base model.
The unknown ΔΔGu label achieves a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.00 and an accuracy of 1.
JanusDDG shows a mean squared error (MSE) of 2.10 and an accuracy of 0.78.
